# GitHub Copilot Skills Agent Instructions

## Owner

- `baldin_project_manager` for workflow fit; relevant specialist owner for technical content.

## Scope

- Applies to Copilot workspace skill folders.

## Do

- Use skills for repeatable workflows with tested instructions.
- Keep skill metadata discoverable with clear "Use when" descriptions.

## Do Not

- Do not add skills for one-off tasks.
- Do not hide policy changes inside skills only.

## Validation

- Run the agentic validator when requested.
- Check skill frontmatter and local links.

## Handback Notes

- Report trigger phrases and workflow boundaries.
